description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Mean' class, which computes the arithmetic mean of a set of values, either incrementally or from stored data. The class provides methods for evaluating the mean of arrays with optional weighting, and manages internal state via a 'FirstMoment' object.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: Implements the calculation of the arithmetic mean, supports incremental and batch evaluation, with optional weighting. Extends AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic for common statistical behavior, and implements Serializable and WeightedEvaluation for object serialization and weighted computations.
